title: PromptReel Weekly: Claude goes 3D with Blender MCP (Oct 26, 2026)
html:
PromptReel Weekly · Oct 26, 2026

This week Claude went full 3D: Blender MCP setups, a mascot animated with no After Effects, and one prompt that renders nine ads.

5 new videos and the prompts behind them

  1. Clawd — No After Effects by @0xwhrrari
    Claude Opus 5.5 scripts Blender 5 + Cycles to animate the Claude Code mascot inside a faithful After Effects-style workspace, no AE involved.
  2. Blender MCP + Remotion character animation stack by @beamnxw
    Two install commands wire Claude Code to Blender and Remotion so it can model, animate and render a character clip.
  3. Squirrel vs crocodile river: 20s, 20 beats by @socialwithaayan
    A Seedance 2.5 prompt that plans a 20-second chase beat by beat, with a locked character reference for the squirrel.
  4. ALTER: Claude skill to restyle a video you already shot by @Scenario_gg
    A Claude skill that keeps your footage frame for frame and swaps only what you name, like the outfit.
  5. Opus 5.5 + Remotion: one prompt, nine ad videos by @Asteri_eth
    One reusable Remotion composition rendered in 3 brand themes x 3 formats, with a contact sheet to review.

Trending repos this week

  • cloudflare/security-audit-skill (+15,072 stars this week)
    A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with verified, machine-readable findings.
  • stablyai/orca (+9,622 stars this week)
    One place to run a fleet of coding agents like Claude Code on your own subscriptions.
  • Graphify-Labs/graphify (+6,903 stars this week)
    Turns a codebase and its docs into a queryable knowledge graph, as a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

Prompt tip

Lock length and frame rate before anything else ("20s at 30fps = 600 frames"), then assign each beat a frame range. Agents stop drifting on timing when every scene has exact start and end frames.
